checks.name: legacy_source_actual_offline_cli
command:
import io,json,socket,sys
from contextlib import redirect_stdout
from pathlib import Path
from itov.catalog import sha256
from itov.catalog_store import CatalogStore
from itov.cli import main
from itov.config import load_config
config=load_config(Path('workspace/itov.toml'))
trial=json.loads(Path('docs/evidence/stage-11-training-attempt-04-20260921.json').read_bytes())
export=json.loads(Path('docs/evidence/stage-11-comfy-export-qualified-20260921.json').read_bytes())
paths={p:sha256((config.root/p).read_bytes()) for p in trial['prior_file_sha256']}
head=CatalogStore(config.root).snapshot(require_clean=True).head
def forbidden(*args,**kwargs): raise AssertionError('Offline verification attempted network')
socket.socket.connect=forbidden
def call(command,expected=0):
 out=io.StringIO()
 with redirect_stdout(out): code=main(command+['--json'])
 assert code==expected,(command,code,out.getvalue())
 return json.loads(out.getvalue())
plan=trial['plan_path']
assert call(['training','status',plan])['status']=='succeeded'
assessment=call(['evaluation','assess',plan,'--save'])
assert assessment==trial['assessment']
candidate=call(['training','candidate',plan,'--save'])
assert candidate==export['candidate']
assert call(['promotion','prepare',plan],1)['scope']=='promotion_refused'
assert call(['trigger','lint','examples/trigger.rules.json'])['ok']
assert all(sha256((config.root/p).read_bytes())==h for p,h in paths.items())
assert CatalogStore(config.root).snapshot(require_clean=True).head==head
assert not any(n in sys.modules for n in ('torch','diffusers','peft','PIL'))
print('Actual status/assessment/candidate revalidation and promotion refusal passed; zero network; preserved',len(paths),'prior files and main catalog; no ML imports')

checks.name: source_curated_offline_cli
command:
import io,json,socket,sys
from contextlib import redirect_stdout
from pathlib import Path
from itov.catalog import sha256
from itov.catalog_store import CatalogStore
from itov.cli import main
from itov.config import load_config
config=load_config(Path('workspace/itov.toml'))
trial=json.loads(Path('docs/evidence/stage-11b-training-attempt-03-20260922.json').read_bytes())
assert trial['passed']
paths={p:sha256((config.root/p).read_bytes()) for p in trial['prior_file_sha256']}
head=CatalogStore(config.root).snapshot(require_clean=True).head
def forbidden(*args,**kwargs): raise AssertionError('Offline replay attempted network')
socket.socket.connect=forbidden
commands=[(['dataset','curate','workspace/training/data/met-still-life-v1/curation.json','--save'],0),
          (['training','status',trial['plan_path']],0),
          (['evaluation','assess',trial['plan_path'],'--save'],0),
          (['training','candidate',trial['plan_path'],'--save'],0),
          (['evaluation','packet',trial['plan_path'],'--save'],0),
          (['promotion','prepare',trial['plan_path']],1)]
for command,expected in commands:
    for as_json in (True,False):
        out=io.StringIO()
        with redirect_stdout(out): code=main(command+(['--json'] if as_json else []))
        assert code==expected,(command,out.getvalue())
        if as_json:
            value=json.loads(out.getvalue())
            if command[:2]==['evaluation','packet']: assert value==trial['packet']
            if command[:2]==['evaluation','assess']: assert value==trial['assessment']
            if command[:2]==['training','candidate']: assert value==trial['candidate']
        else: assert out.getvalue().strip() and not out.getvalue().startswith('{')
assert all(sha256((config.root/p).read_bytes())==h for p,h in paths.items())
assert CatalogStore(config.root).snapshot(require_clean=True).head==head
assert not any(n in sys.modules for n in ('torch','diffusers','peft','PIL'))
print('Six actual curated CLI commands in JSON and text passed offline; retained',len(paths),'prior files and catalog; no ML imports')
checks.stdout: Six actual curated CLI commands in JSON and text passed offline; retained 146 prior files and catalog; no ML imports
